Layover Planner

Check if your connection is feasible: layover length versus the airport's minimum connect time, with a buffer verdict and rebooking guidance.

Guidance

Typical minimum connect times — always confirm the official MCT with your airline before booking.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter when your inbound flight lands and when the outbound departs.
  2. Pick the connecting airport (with its typical minimum connect time) or set a custom minimum.
  3. Say whether you must clear immigration or re-check bags.
  4. Press Check for the layover length, the verdict and what to do if it is tight.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a minimum connect time (MCT)?

The shortest connection an airport/airline officially allows, covering deplaning, terminal transfer and boarding. The built-in values are typical; your airline's actual MCT is on the ticket.

Why add immigration and baggage?

International-to-domestic connections need passport control and often bag re-check, which can add 30–60 minutes beyond the standard MCT.

What if my layover is below the minimum?

The tool flags it as not feasible: do not book it — if delays hit, the airline may still rebook you, but you will likely misconnect.
